melody.name: Melody
melody.means: The overall level of the picture.
melody.listen: The line goes up when the overall level goes up.

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.listen: One note means one kind of value; more notes mean a mix.

bass.name: Bass
bass.means: The shift from normal, or from the first date.
bass.listen: Low notes are below, high notes above.

hotspots.name: Hot spots
hotspots.means: Each area that stands out, as one voice.
hotspots.listen: Higher notes are stronger areas; left and right show where they are.

rhythm.name: Rhythm
rhythm.means: The edges: where the picture changes sharply.
rhythm.listen: Busy notes mean a sharp boundary; calm notes mean a smooth field.

motion.name: Motion
motion.means: How fast the picture moves, and which way.
motion.listen: Open and bright is quick; a sweep to the right is eastward.

time.name: Time
time.means: Where you are in the dates.
time.listen: A pulse for each date; an accent when the month or the year changes.

solo.hotspots: Hot spots: 1, the largest is a low one in the centre

firstFrame.summary: The overall level is low; 1 hot spot, the largest in the centre.
